name: Humanoid HMND 01 Alpha Wheeled
summary: A 2.20 m, 300 kg wheeled industrial humanoid from London for tote and box handling, tested at Siemens Erlangen and going into Schaeffler plants in Germany from December 2026 under robot-as-a-service.

germany.statusNote: Offered through an "Early Access" request; deployments run as robot-as-a-service. Pilots done in Germany (Siemens Erlangen, Schaeffler Herzogenaurach); first live production deployments at two Schaeffler sites in Germany run from December 2026 to June 2027. No public price and no general delivery date for other buyers.
germany.leadTime: First German production deployments from December 2026 (Schaeffler).

sellers.name: Humanoid (SKL Robotics Ltd)
sellers.note: Early Access request form on the website; robot-as-a-service model.

specs.label: Payload
specs.conditions: As stated; not specified per arm

specs.label: DoF per hand
specs.conditions: Optional 5-finger hand; 1-DoF parallel gripper as alternative

specs.label: Sensors
specs.value: RGB and depth cameras, 6D force/torque sensors, wrist cameras, haptic feedback sensors

specs.label: AI stack
specs.value: KinetIQ four-layer AI stack on NVIDIA compute

specs.label: Dual-arm payload in pilot
specs.conditions: Limit used in the Martur Fompak pilot

capabilities.sdk: Robot API; KinetIQ fleet orchestration; tested with SAP EWM and Siemens Xcelerator
notes: End effector chosen per deployment: 12-DoF five-finger hand or 1-DoF parallel gripper.
Siemens pilot: 60 tote moves per hour, more than 8 h uptime, over 90 % pick-and-place success.
Payload 15 kg is not stated per arm; an 8 kg dual-arm limit was used in one pilot.

evidence.note: Agreement announced 2026-05-13: robot-as-a-service deployment from December 2026 to June 2027 at Herzogenaurach (box handling) and Schweinfurt (integration testing and validation); four-digit wheeled unit count targeted by 2032. Not started yet.

evidence.task: Took KLT boxes from a pallet and delivered them to a trolley, tasked by SAP EWM
evidence.where: Martur Fompak (automotive supplier; country not stated)
